q: I’m sleeping 16–18 hours a day and still have no energy. I feel so drained that I’m basically bedridden most days.
cx: Nearly 25 weeks, sickness kept her off supplements.

q: I saw some videos online about it and they honestly traumatized me.
cx: Videos about a side effect of a treatment she is about to have.

q: I force myself to cook and clean but it’s always the bare minimum. I’m just so tired all the time. I’m also taking care of a two-year-old toddler who is 1000% “on” all the time.
cx: Tired in a second pregnancy with a two-year-old.

q: Luckily my husband is amazing and does so much. I’m just tired!
cx: When told there is no quick fix for the tiredness.

q: My husband tries his best to help, but I know it’s a lot for him too sometimes. On top of everything, I’m far from my parents right now and I miss them more than I expected to.
cx: 10+4, first pregnancy.

q: Between the fatigue and the nausea, I haven’t been able to work or even get through small daily tasks.
cx: What the first trimester has stopped.

q: I’ve also been hungry and nauseated at the same time, which is such a strange combination. I keep craving *something* but can’t figure out what it actually is.
cx: Describing first-trimester appetite.

q: Im really worried that I wont be able to lose weight before my wedding and get the dress I want. Im an active person and I work out but I wanna feel good in my dress and I've seen women during post partum and it dosent look encouraging!!
cx: Due in December, wedding ten months after.

q: I have a 15 month old currently. So I bought a double stroller and I’m using a bassinet for my newborn. I’ve never used a bassinet stroller
cx: Second baby due end of July.

q: I’m both hungry for any new bit of information about her and absolutely overwhelmed and almost wish I knew nothing but “she’s fine and she’ll be here in December” 😂
cx: Referred for a detailed scan to check dates.

q: I’m a FTM and have no idea what to expect, so knowing MFM is ultimately a good thing makes me feel a lot more reassured.
cx: What a stranger's reply did for her.

q: I just feel silly for even going in, for the extra cost and not trying harder to get in contact with my OB after hours
cx: 22 weeks, after a hospital visit for groin pain.

q: I got a referral for pelvic floor PT before the er visit and can’t get in until August.
cx: Waiting two months for physio.

q: Then I ask about scheduling my first appointment and they say “We have to wait for your labs to come back.” 🤦🏻‍♀️The labs that nobody has bothered to order over the past week.
cx: Five weeks, after a past loss; her OB's office hasn't acted.

q: I just want to feel like I’m doing something and have any information that may be available to let me know if this pregnancy is progressing.
cx: Waiting on her OB's office.

q: i feel really overwhelmed by people reaching out and asking “wheres the baby”
cx: 40+3, first baby.

q: it just feels rly bothersome at this point of pregnancy when someone texts to ask if the babys been born instead of just checking on me
cx: What she wants from texts at 40+3.

q: someone even said “poor baby” bc he hasnt come out, as if he is not living it up in the dark comfy hot tub womb i made for him.
cx: A comment about being past her due date.

q: two people with my same due date that i know peripherally have already had their babies, i just feel like spontaneous labor is never coming.
cx: Overdue with her first.

q: they have rotating OBs/midwives, so I'm seeing a different provider for basically every appointment. This would be fine if there were only 3-4 providers and I could actually get to know each of them before I give birth, but there are 22!!!
cx: Rural US; only one practice within ninety minutes.

q: I tried to schedule all of my appointments in advance with the one midwife I know I like, but the scheduler said they "aren't allowed to do that."
cx: Trying to see the same midwife.

q: Some of the midwives/OBs are good and some are truly awful, and it's completely luck of the draw.
cx: Her rotating practice.

q: I worked with a fertility clinic to get pregnant, and I think I got spoiled by how communicative and attentive they were lol. I forget how crappy women's healthcare can be and how much self-advocacy really is required.
cx: Comparing prenatal care with her fertility clinic.
